blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I'm going to teach you some karate.
exercises.why: **поучить → поучу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's call each other tomorrow.
exercises.why: **созвониться → созвонимся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: ___ (сжать) я губы бутоном, чтобы не сболтнуть лишнего.
exercises.prompt: I gonna button my lips so the truth don't slip.
exercises.why: **сжать → Сожму** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Your hair will grow back.
exercises.why: **отрасти → отрастут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's synchronize our watches.
exercises.why: **сверить → сверим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: When's the wedding?
exercises.why: **состояться → состоится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: ___ (подойти) любое жильё, лишь бы арендная плата была вменяемой.
exercises.prompt: Any apartment will do as long as the rent is reasonable.
exercises.why: **подойти → Подойдёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let me look at you.
exercises.why: **посмотреть → посмотрю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Tom will adapt quickly.
exercises.why: **приспособиться → приспособится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll shoot both of you.
exercises.why: **пристрелить → пристрелю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Your plan is sure to succeed.
exercises.why: **удаться → удастся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: He'll not live to make old bones.
exercises.why: **дожить → доживёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I will bite off just a little bit.
exercises.why: **куснуть → кусну** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'm going to turn in early tonight.
exercises.why: **завалиться → завалюсь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Flattery will get you nowhere.
exercises.why: **добиться → добьёшься** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: ___ (подержать) конверт внутренней стороной над кипящим чайником — марка отклеится.
exercises.prompt: Hold the envelope with the inside facing down over a boiling kettle—the stamp will come off.
exercises.why: **подержать → Подержите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (выиграть) время, если пойдём напрямик через поле.
exercises.prompt: It'll save time if we cut across the field.
exercises.why: **выиграть → выиграем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Romeo marries Juliet.
exercises.why: **жениться → женится** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (проклясть) тот день, когда подло обошёлся со мной.
exercises.prompt: You'll rue the day you wronged me.
exercises.why: **проклясть → проклянёшь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Like always, the truth will triumph.
exercises.why: **восторжествовать → восторжествует** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
